repairs.symptom: vector core exception (507035) on every shape where a core owns two or more rows, i.e. rows > 40 on this 40-AIV 910B
repairs.root_cause: row results were packed with Duplicate at a 4-byte offset; vector instructions require 32-byte-aligned UB addresses
repairs.fix: each row result occupies its own 32-byte UB block and is flushed with one 4-byte DataCopyPad through a VECOUT queue
